notes.title: The Demo is LIVE – Try It Free!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, forest defenders! 🌿[/h2][p]We’ve got some exciting news: [b]the official demo for Jungle Defenders is now live![/b][/p][p]This is your chance to get a first taste of the game, experience the chaos of battle, and meet the animal heroes fighting back against the mechanical threat.[/p][p]Our goal with this demo is to introduce you to the game’s world, core gameplay, and the heart of our vision.
[/p][h2]⚔️ About the demo:[/h2][p][b]Single-player only (for now!)[/b][/p][p][b]Battle waves of robotic enemies in intense arenas[/b][/p][p][b]Try out each character’s unique abilities[/b][/p][p][b]Discover a roguelike with a powerful environmental message[/b][/p][h3]
[b]Our world map is being built!
[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655748/1557f02b18bf0ebc846b847b5966e9566655a722.png"][/img]
[b]Play as Katness and unlock Mr.Frog!
[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655748/ac21a7bba532c609d20264fec1e8ddbbcd853b41.png"][/img]
[b]Choose game-breaking Artifacts to create unique builds!
[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655748/13eecdeec31ebb288ad661a0d0573b792fc5bf15.png"][/img][/h3][p]
[b]🌱 Note: This is an early version, and many features are still in development. Things like online multiplayer, new maps, additional characters, upgrades, and more are coming — but we wanted you to experience the soul of the game right now!
[/b][/p][h2]💬 We’re super open to feedback, so feel free to share your thoughts here or on our [url="https://discord.gg/7A2fCu4Frk"]Discord[/url]![/h2][p]

[/p]
